name: WhisperLive - GPU
description:
A real-time transcription application that uses the OpenAI Whisper model to convert speech input into text output. It can be used to transcribe both live audio input from microphone and pre-recorded audio files. 
        [br]
        This version runs on an Nvidia GPU.
requires: The image for this container is quite large.

gpus.description: NVIDIA GPU pass-through. Requires the NVIDIA driver / container toolkit on the host (Unraid: install the Nvidia-Driver plugin).
